title: Chapter 1422 - 5: Lin Yuan Going All Out (Part 2)
content:
Chapter 1422 - 5: Lin Yuan Going All Out (Part 2)

Chapter 1422 - 5: Lin Yuan Going All Out (Part 2)

"This lord-level material can indeed be integrated into the Origin Clock."

Lin Yuan observed for a moment and concluded.

However, that will have to wait until we leave the Wanwei space-time. This time, the Taiji Primordial Spirit didn't carry many treasures, and naturally, the Origin Clock, as a life weapon, wasn't brought along.

Firstly, the Origin Clock, which is only at the First Realm, doesn't offer much help to Lin Yuan.

Secondly, the Wanwei space-time is full of dangers, and Lin Yuan only dispatched the Taiji Primordial Spirit, having prepared for the worst.

That is, the Taiji Primordial Spirit might fall within the Wanwei space-time.

Thus, it's best not to carry valuable treasures if possible.

Merely losing the Taiji Primordial Spirit doesn't constitute a high cost for Lin Yuan.

On the other side of the Wanwei space-time.

Seven or eight figures stood there.

Lord Ye Wu was shrouded in white mist, gazing into the depths of the Wanwei space-time, glancing at the three or four Time Lords standing behind him.

Clearly, among the seven or eight figures, Lord Ye Wu and two

other lords were leading, while the remaining five Time Lords stood behind these three lords, holding a lesser position.

"Rest assured, whether or not we gain anything from this entry into the Wanwei space-time, I will provide you all with tens of thousands of pounds of Time Sand," Lord Ye Wu said.

The five Time Lords behind him were all newly minted Time Lords, specifically hired by him.

The purpose was to have a backup to hold off other lords when vying for critical treasures and wonders within the Wanwei space-time.

Newly minted Time Lords, while not as powerful as those formidable Time Lords, can still be of some use if they entangle themselves wholeheartedly.

"Thank you, Brother Ye Wu."

"Rest assured, Brother Ye Wu. We will obey orders this time in the Wanwei space-time."

The five Time Lords immediately spoke up, knowing that they would receive tens of thousands of pounds of Time Sand regardless of the outcome, which served as a 'bottom line' income.

What's more, Lord Ye Wu didn't care about their other gains within the Wanwei space-time.

With such a powerful lord like Lord Ye Wu leading them, as they venture deep into the Wanwei space-time, they could gather any treasure or wonder, rendering the venture worthwhile.

In the blink of an eye, Lin Yuan had been exploring the Wanwei space-time for three thousand years.

He had encountered other Time Lords twice, but neither side

engaged in combat, merely retreating after eye contact.

Unless it involved coveted treasures and wonders, Time Lords rarely act directly, especially within the Wanwei space-time, where the presence of other lurking Time Lords in the vicinity is

unknown.

Without the ability to observe future timelines, Time Lords are very cautious.

"Three thousand years, and in this Wanwei space-time, apart from initially obtaining a lord-level material worth two thousand pounds of Time Sand, there have been no other gains?"

Lin Yuan maintained a state of exploration, feeling a bit helpless.

But on second thought, this was the common experience for Time Lords exploring the Wanwei space-time.

In just three thousand years, expecting any major gains was unrealistic, and obtaining a lord-level raw material could already be considered exceptionally lucky.

After all, this isn't the deep regions of Wanwei space-time but the

border areas, which have been explored countless times.

Although there were no gains in the Wanwei space-time, over three thousand years, Lin Yuan made significant progress in his understanding of the fourth Source World.

In the Chaos Void.

Lin Yuan's true form sat cross-legged.

Before him, strands of Tai Chu power interwove and clashed, faintly

nurturing another form of "Tai' power.

"The first of the 'Innate Five Great' is Tai Chu, followed by Tai Shi, but this 'Tai Shi"..."

Flashes of insight surged in Lin Yuan's mind regarding the 'Innate

Five Great, and he had a nascent understanding of the second "Tai!

However, fully comprehending it would still take some time, though with the support of the fourth Source World, it likely wouldn't take

too long.

"Hmm?"

At this moment, Lin Yuan's expression changed.

"Wanwei space-time...

Lin Yuan's gaze looked far into the direction of the Wanwei

space-time.

Clearly, the Taiji Primordial Spirit within the Wanwei space-time

had made a new discovery.

...

Within the Wanwei space-time.

Lin Yuan suddenly stopped, looking in another direction.

A vast area of space was torn, and a small mountain drifted out from

the rift.

In the Wanwei space-time, space isn't very stable and often tears apart, but with the Time Lords' mastery of time and space, they can

completely detect and avoid it in advance.

"What is that?"

Lin Yuan's pupils constricted as the small mountain drifting out

from the torn space was filled with rich power of time.

"A Time Mountain, entirely composed of Time Sand?"

Lin Yuan took a deep breath.

His entire wealth amounted to only a few thousand pounds of Time Sand, yet how many pounds could that Time Mountain composed

of Time Sand be?

Millions of pounds?

Or tens of millions of pounds?

"Great opportunity."

Lin Yuan's heartbeat accelerated: "This torn space must connect to

the depths of the Wanwei space-time, causing the treasures there to drift to the outer region through the spatial rift, eventually being discovered by me?"

Countless thoughts flashed through Lin Yuan's mind, eventually

converging into one-

This is mine.

The Time Mountain is mine.

By acquiring this Time Mountain, Lin Yuan could completely

transition from a poor Time Lord to an affluent one.

Buzz. Lin Yuan's figure disappeared, reappearing next to the spatial rift, stretching out his hand to seize the Time Mountain.

Another direction.

A bald figure also gazes towards the vast, torn space rift.

This figure is a Time Lord who has just entered the second level; His cold eyes look towards the distant space rift.

"Mountain?"

This Time Lord is somewhat bewildered, noticing the mountain

composed entirely of time sand.

But in the next moment.

A figure appears beside the mountain and takes the Time Mountain

away.

"No!!"

The Bald Time Lord feels his heart bleeding; he is far from the space

rift and hasn't reacted yet, but the Time Mountain has already been

claimed by another lord.

"Which lord is he?" The Bald Time Lord observes Lin Yuan.

"After such a long time, still exploring the outskirts of Wanwei

space, he's certainly not a Time Lord at the pinnacle of the second level." The Bald Time Lord concludes, "At most, he has just entered the second level, maybe even a Time Lord in the first level." The Bald Time Lord breathes a sigh of relief, his heart deciding.

If it were just ordinary treasures, he most likely wouldn't take any action if another lord claimed them first.

After all, the treasures are already in the other's hands, and

reclaiming them is too difficult.

But that Time Mountain?

The Bald Time Lord still wants to try and contest it.

With this thought.

The Bald Time Lord's figure instantly vanishes from where he stood.

...

"Got it."

Lin Yuan stores the Time Mountain within his inner universe and

immediately begins moving away in another direction.

"This mountain?"

Lin Yuan's spirit is excited.

Suddenly.

A figure appears in the distance.

At the same time.

An intangible aura permeates the earth and the sky.

Lin Yuan furrows his brows, stopping.

"Sir."

The Bald Time Lord stares at Lin Yuan: "I saw that mountain too,

and it's not fair for you to monopolize it." "You saw it too?"

Lin Yuan instantly understands.

The Time Mountain drifting out from the space rift was taken by

him in a very short time.

But ultimately, it wasn't completely flawless.

The Bald Time Lord also saw it, and there's nothing that can be

done.

"What do you want to do?"

Lin Yuan directly asks.

"Give me half."

The Bald Time Lord states: "As long as you agree, only you and I will

know about this, and we can safely leave the Wanwei space."

The implication is.

If Lin Yuan doesn't agree, the matter will be made public. Then for sure, other Time Lords will be tempted, even Time Lords

at the pinnacle of the second level might intervene.

"My demand isn't high."

The Bald Time Lord says.

He isn't confident in being able to hold onto Lin Yuan. With only initial second-level strength, he can't completely

overpower a first-level Time Lord.

That's why he requested half.

"Not high demand?" Lin Yuan frowns.

He's certainly unwilling to split his gains for no reason.

But the Bald Time Lord's threat does influence Lin Yuan.

"Want half of the mountain, words alone won't do." Lin Yuan thinks for a moment, deciding: "Take one of my moves, if you can handle

it, I'll agree to your request."

If the Bald Time Lord withstands Lin Yuan's move without issue, it

means the opponent's strength can match him.

In such a scenario, to prevent future troubles, dividing half of the

Time Mountain is the wisest choice. "Take one of your moves?" The Bald Time Lord laughs.

Wanwei space has been opened for thousands of years, and a Time

Lord still exploring the peripheral regions at this time, what

strength could he have?

"Not just one move, even ten or a hundred moves..."

The Bald Time Lord is very confident. However, before he can finish speaking. Not far away, Lin Yuan extends his hand, the aura is heavy and

oppressive, strands of power seemingly originating from the

beginning converge, forming an all-encompassing prison, vast and

boundless, pressing towards the Bald Time Lord.

"This?"

The Bald Time Lord feels suffocated.
